response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong web/backend background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and some hardware-adjacent exposure, but he does not meet the core requirements of this role. There is no evidence of Japanese language ability (a hard, native-level requirement), no Linux kernel analysis or source modification experience, and no networking-security domain work (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching, switch SDKs). His C/C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments over a decade ago, and he is Berlin-based, which adds relocation friction for a role that appears to be Japan-based. The gap between his profile and the job's mandatory qualifications is too large to justify an interview.
strengths: 13+ years of professional software development across many domains
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, open-source ownership
Some low-level and systems exposure (C/C++ at NI, Linux, robotics, embedded/hardware projects)
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency indicated (hard requirement)
No Linux kernel investigation or source-code modification experience
No network security or LAN-switch domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3, switch chips)

key_factors.factor: Minimal recent C / UNIX kernel development
